name: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust
tagline: A specialty finance company investing primarily in mortgage-related assets and mortgage servicing rights.
hero_kpi_rationale: La marge d'intérêt nette est l'indicateur clé de rentabilité pour un REIT spécialisé en finance hypothécaire, reflétant la capacité de l'entreprise à générer des revenus nets à partir de ses actifs et passifs portant intérêt.

kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and interest expense divided by average interest-earning assets, showing profitability from core lending and investment operations.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational profitability for mortgage REIT.
kpis.description: Measures the spread between interest earned on assets and interest paid on liabilities, reflecting core business efficiency.

kpis.name_fr: Portefeuille de droits de gestion hypothécaire
kpis.explanation: Fair value of mortgage servicing rights portfolio, a key earnings driver representing the present value of future servicing income.
kpis.signal: Critical asset component and earnings contributor for mortgage servicers.
kpis.description: Represents the estimated fair value of the right to service mortgage loans, a significant portion of the investment portfolio.

kpis.explanation: Total volume of mortgage loans produced through correspondent production activities, indicating business origination activity.
kpis.signal: Measures the scale of correspondent production and loan origination business.
kpis.description: Total dollar volume of mortgage loans originated through correspondent lending channels.

kpis.explanation: Number of employees employed by the company, managed indirectly through PFSI subsidiaries.
kpis.signal: Indicator of company size and organizational structure (externally managed).
kpis.description: Total headcount employed directly or through PFSI subsidiaries performing management and servicing activities.
